estimates.rationale: Foundation layer: new domain model + Alembic migration (sku/location/quantity/tracking_code, unique constraint R3), full boundary→service→repository stack, React SPA form with inline validation + empty-state + index/detail views, and E2E coverage — broad surface with no prior scaffold to inherit.

Builds entirely on FP1's stack; adds one adjustment endpoint, below-zero guard (R2), audit timestamp+actor fields (R1), and optimistic in-place React update (R5) — contained scope but the optimistic-UI pattern adds moderate front-end complexity.

Introduces a new Supplier entity (model + migration + FK), a Receipt event model, a distinct inbound service flow that increments stock, and a new form + confirmation UI — net-new domain objects and a second aggregate alongside stock records.

Pick event model + migration, transactional overcommit check (R2 enforcement at write time with race-condition safety), stock-decrement service, and inline rejection UI naming the shortfall — concurrency correctness and the constraint path add meaningful complexity beyond FP2.
Read-side aggregation only: a SKU detail view that queries existing stock rows across locations — no new writes, no new domain model, just a new route + query + React page on top of FP1's data model.
